# YouGlish

> > YouGlish helps you master pronunciation in multiple languages using real YouTube video clips from native speakers.

YouGlish is a language learning platform that leverages YouTube content to provide authentic pronunciation examples across English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Chinese. The tool searches millions of video clips featuring native speakers, including public figures like Angela Merkel and Barack Obama, to help learners hear words in real-world contexts.

## Key Topics

- pronunciation learning
- native speaker examples
- YouTube-based learning
- video pronunciation guides
- accent variants (US, UK, Australian)
- multilingual support (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese)
- context-based language learning
- real-world speech examples
- regional accents (France, Canada, Belgium, Spain, Latin America)
- Mandarin Chinese (China, Taiwan)
- Brazilian vs European Portuguese
- video clip search
- authentic language content

## Core Pronunciation Tools

- [English Pronunciation (Spanish Interface)](https://es.youglish.com): English pronunciation tool with Obama, Clinton examples and accent variants
- [English Pronunciation (Italian Interface)](https://it.youglish.com): English pronunciation learning with examples from Obama, Clinton speeches
- [German Pronunciation](https://youglish.com/german): German pronunciation mastery with 10M+ clips from native speakers
- [About YouGlish](https://youglish.com/about): About YouGlish pronunciation tool, features, and multi-language support

## French Pronunciation Guides

- [French Pronunciation (German Interface)](https://de.youglish.com/french): French pronunciation learning tool using YouTube videos from France/Canada
- [French Pronunciation (Italian Interface)](https://it.youglish.com/french): French pronunciation learning with examples from France, Canada, Belgium
- [French Pronunciation (Spanish Interface)](https://es.youglish.com/french): French pronunciation tool with native speaker videos from multiple regions
- [French Pronunciation (French Interface)](https://fr.youglish.com/french): French pronunciation practice with videos from France, Canada, Belgium

## German Pronunciation Guides

- [German Pronunciation (French Interface)](https://fr.youglish.com/german): German pronunciation guide with examples from Angela Merkel, Martin Schulz
- [German Pronunciation (Italian Interface)](https://it.youglish.com/german): German pronunciation practice with Angela Merkel and Martin Schulz examples
- [German Pronunciation (Portuguese Interface)](https://pt.youglish.com/german): German pronunciation learning with Angela Merkel and Martin Schulz clips

## Spanish & Portuguese Pronunciation

- [Spanish Pronunciation (German Interface)](https://de.youglish.com/spanish): Spanish pronunciation learning covering Spain and Latin America accents
- [Spanish Pronunciation (Portuguese Interface)](https://pt.youglish.com/spanish): Spanish pronunciation tool covering Spain and Latin America accents
- [Portuguese Pronunciation (French Interface)](https://fr.youglish.com/portuguese): Portuguese pronunciation tool covering Brazilian and European variants
- [Portuguese Pronunciation (German Interface)](https://de.youglish.com/portuguese): Portuguese pronunciation tool for Brazilian and European Portuguese

## Italian & Chinese Pronunciation

- [Italian Pronunciation (German Interface)](https://de.youglish.com/italian): Italian pronunciation guide with native speaker examples via YouTube
- [Chinese Pronunciation (French Interface)](https://fr.youglish.com/chinese): Mandarin Chinese pronunciation tool covering China and Taiwan variants
- [Chinese Pronunciation (German Interface)](https://de.youglish.com/chinese): Mandarin Chinese pronunciation guide for China and Taiwan speakers
